definitions: A person or thing that divides.
A tool, typically a compass-like instrument with two pointed legs, used for measuring, marking, or dividing lines or distances.
A partition or screen that separates one area from another.
A component in an electrical circuit that divides a voltage or current.
examples: The room divider created two distinct spaces.
He used a divider to mark the equal segments on the line.
The voltage divider circuit is essential for this project.
She acted as a divider of the group, causing a rift.
